defaults.style_description: chunky pixel art game button icons, dark outline, warm shading

request.description: head and shoulders portrait of a townsman in a long cloth kaftan and a cap; Drawn with a wooden bucket in the left hand and an axe in the right .
head and shoulders portrait of short svita, an axe in the belt, a shovel, a sack on the back.
head and shoulders portrait of chapel-de-fer, quilted coat, longbow, red cloak.
close view of a bronze barrel on a two-wheeled carriage with a trail, two gunners; on the march a horse pulls it trail first; it fires with a flash, smoke and recoil.
head and shoulders portrait of green-brown clothes, a hood, a longbow, a quiver, a knife; no armour.

head and shoulders portrait of a gunner with a heavy hook gun () on his shoulder, the hook under the barrel; in battle he levels it . The doc's helper with the match is not drawn: one figure carries the gun and a smouldering match cord.
head and shoulders portrait of mail or quilted coat, a simple helmet, a small shield, three sulitsa javelins, a sword, a small horse without a caparison.
head and shoulders portrait of a bascinet with a visor, brigandine with plate arms, a shield with the Pogoń, a lance with a pennon, the horse in a red caparison.
head and shoulders portrait of hides over linen, a Lithuanian shield on the arm, a spear and a battle axe at the belt; no Christian signs, no mail.
head and shoulders portrait of full plate of about 1500, a sallet with a bevor, a red tunic over the plate, a long lance with a two-tailed pennon, the heavy horse with a chanfron.
close view of a four-wheeled cart with plank sides under matting, two horses, a driver, cargo showing at the back.
head and shoulders portrait of an old woman: linen shirt and belt, dark svita, white namitka, herbs, staff.

head and shoulders portrait of Princess Anastasia of Slutsk, a mature widow: a dark rich dress to the ground, the white widow's kerchief and povoi, a short fur cloak over it. No portrait of her exists (the doc: do not take late drawings as a base): the face and colours are a guess. She does not fight: idle and walk only.

head and shoulders portrait of Andrei Gintovt, about 20, the khorunzhy of the land nobility of Ostrogski: plate of about 1500 under a long green kaftan, an open sallet, his family's woven belt, a small gold Orthodox cross, the khorugv in his hand with the (placeholder) Gintovt arms of folk_1435 (a white zigzag on green), the same arms on the caparison.

head and shoulders portrait of pani Barbara, Jaśko's granddaughter, about 25, a Gdańsk merchant's wife: a gown of good dark blue wool to the ground with fur at the hem, cuffs and collar, a married townswoman's white linen headdress (a padded roll under the linen, a veil down the back and a wimple under the chin), the counting book in her left hand, keys and a purse at a girdle in the player colour. No weapons.

head and shoulders portrait of Prince Mikhail Bulgakov-Golitsa, voivode of the Right Hand: mature, greying, : a kolontar of large steel plates with gilt rows over mail, gilt vambraces, a short blue kaftan skirt, a shishak with a small team-coloured yalovets on the spike, a lance with a pennon , a dark bay with a blue chaprak edged in silver.

head and shoulders portrait of Jan Čapek of Sány, the captain of the Czech orphans: no lord's finery, a dark brigandine over mail, plain plate arms, an open sallet, a dark beard; a lance with the Hussite banner , a small white shield with the red chalice, a black horse with only a team saddle cloth.

head and shoulders portrait of King Casimir IV Jagiellon, 27: young and clean shaven, long brown hair under an open bascinet with a gold crown, plate of the 1450s under a crimson royal mantle with an ermine collar, a sword ; a dark grey horse under a crimson caparison. Beside him on foot the bearer of the royal banner: the crowned White Eagle on red (the Kingdom's arms; the banner the German sources say was taken), mail, a red tabard, a kettle hat.

head and shoulders portrait of Ivan Chelyadnin, boyar and master of the horse (), commander of the Large Regiment. : mail and a bakhterets with gilt rows under a wide dark green ferjaz with gold edging (Shchenya's is red), a gilt-rimmed tall shishak with a mail barmitsa, a dark full beard, a drawn sabre , a white horse of the master of the horse with a crimson chaprak edged in gold, the eastern saddle.
head and shoulders portrait of two clerics of the council in travelling cloaks over dark cassocks, one in a wide-brimmed hat with a staff, the other hooded with a letter case.

head and shoulders portrait of Oldřich Červenka of Ledce, the Bohemian captain of the mercenaries in Malbork, : bareheaded (short dark hair, a moustache), a breastplate with a short fauld and pauldrons over a doublet of dark wine-red velvet whose sleeves and skirt show, a gold chain, a war hammer , a sword at the hip, a dark bay horse with a team saddle cloth and no caparison. No arms drawn.

head and shoulders portrait of Piotr Dunin of Prawkowice, the commander of the royal mercenaries, a practical soldier in his late forties: plain steel half armour (breastplate, fauld, pauldrons, plate arms; mail at the thighs, riding boots), a short red tabard with his arms Łabędź on the chest (a white swan on red), an open sallet with the bevor over a weathered face with a greying beard, a pear-headed steel mace , a small heater shield with the swan, a sword at the hip, a bay horse with a team saddle cloth and no caparison: the wage-paying captain, not a lord.
head and shoulders portrait of a Samogitian noble about 30, fair hair, short beard, mail, open bascinet, a fur cloak, mounted. hero_kuchmeister: a knight brother in a white cloak, mounted.
head and shoulders portrait of Glinski's messenger: a rich travelling coat, a sword at the belt, a sealed charter () in the hand. A civilian: idle and walk only.

head and shoulders portrait of King Władysław II Jagiełło, about 60, grey, clean shaven: armour of 1410 under a red mantle, a gold crown on an open bascinet, a sword ; his banner is hidden in the story, so the man on foot beside him is a guard with a spear (mail, a kettle hat, a red tabard), not a standard-bearer.

head and shoulders portrait of a mature Polish knight commanding the Crown corps, dark beard, visor raised, plate over a brigandine, a lance with a pennon. His arms are not verified (doc: ), so no charge is drawn: shield per fess white and red, the caparison red with a white band (neutral Polish colours).

head and shoulders portrait of Paweł Jasieński, who opens the battle with the heavy horse: full bright plate with plate legs, a closed sallet with the bevor and a white plume, a short dark green tabard edged in gold, a lance with a two-tailed team pennon , a big grey horse with a chanfron and a dark green caparison with a team trim. His arms are not drawn.

head and shoulders portrait of Jaśko of Łęczyca, a young knight of 22 : mail with a few plain plate pieces (forearms, a dull breastplate), an old bascinet with its visor, a small plain shield (his arms are unknown), a lance with a team pennon, a plain brown horse with only a saddle cloth .

head and shoulders portrait of the Grand Master about 50 in the white cloak with the Grand Master's arms (black cross, gold cross fleury, a gold escutcheon with the black eagle), which his bearer also carries on the banner.

head and shoulders portrait of his younger brother with the same head, in Ruthenian dress of a Švitrigaila man: a long red kaftan over mail, a pointed helmet with an aventail, a fur collar, the same family arms; on his lance under the pennon the woven belt is tied, its ends hanging (the of the mission).

head and shoulders portrait of a Great Polish magnate of the 1450s in full bright plate with plate legs, a sallet with the bevor and the face open, a short crimson velvet tabard edged in gold, a gold chain, a mace , a bay horse under a crimson caparison with a team trim. No family arms.
head and shoulders portrait of Teutonic Order envoy knight brother in a white cloak with a black cross

head and shoulders portrait of the Gdańsk councillor, an elderly rich burgher: a long dark gown to the ankles edged with fur down the front, a fur collar, a gold chain of office, a tall tapering hat in a deep fur brim, a grey beard, a slight stoop; a folded letter with a hanging red seal held out in his right hand.
head and shoulders portrait of a woman in white linen with a dark cloak, greying hair.

head and shoulders portrait of the Livonian Master, mature, grey beard, an open bascinet, the white cloak and the black cross, a sword; his bearer on foot carries the Order's banner (white, black cross). No personal arms are drawn (not verified).
head and shoulders portrait of Michael Küchmeister, a Teutonic knight brother in a white cloak with a black cross, mounted
head and shoulders portrait of an elderly prince, son of Algirdas, leading the Smolensk banners: mail and plate, a pointed helmet, a gold Orthodox cross on the chest, a lance with a pennon.

head and shoulders portrait of Maciej Gintowt, the chronicler, scribe with the hetman, a Samogitian Catholic: a long dark blue-black coat to the ankles (a delia-like overcoat over a żupan), a soft black scholar's cap, a quill behind the cap, an inkwell and a pen case at the belt, a small Catholic cross, the book held in his left hand. Face and colours are invented; a civilian: idle and walk only.

head and shoulders portrait of Marcin of Wrocimowice with the great banner of the Kingdom: a big red banner with the crowned White Eagle on a lance (folk_1514's eagle, the banner of folk_1410), a bascinet, plate arms, a red surcoat, a grey horse with a red caparison .
head and shoulders portrait of the young prince in rich plate of the 1430s, gilt edges, a gold coronet on a visored bascinet, the Pogoń on a red shield and caparison, a sword.

head and shoulders portrait of Mikołaj Gintovt, Gintaut's elder son, about 22: an open bascinet with an aventail, a breastplate under green cloth (a covered cuirass), plate arms, a gold Catholic cross on the neck, the woven belt of his mother at the waist, the family arms on shield and caparison, a sword.

head and shoulders portrait of Mikołaj of Michałów, the Crown's commander of the march, a lord of the 1430s in full white plate (a breastplate with a ridge, a fauld, plate arms) under a plain red surcoat with a white hem (the Crown's colours; his family arms are not drawn), an open bascinet over a dark greying beard, a sword raised in the hand , a grey horse under a red caparison with a team trim.
head and shoulders portrait of a knight brother of the Livonian Order: the white cloak with the black cross, visored bascinet, a lance with a pennon, a white caparison (as hero_wallenrode).

head and shoulders portrait of the fictional centurion () leading the chase (the card: ): a richer syn boyarsky, a spheroconical helmet with a gilt rim and point, a dark red tegilyai, a fur-edged collar, saadak, bow , sabre, a better horse with a small blue chaprak. Everything about his looks is invented.

head and shoulders portrait of Kaspar Nostitz, the mercenary captain holding Chojnice: the same soldierly type with another face and colours: plain steel half armour, a short tabard quartered dark red and white, an open sallet without a bevor over a full, clean-shaven face with fair hair, a war hammer , a black horse with a team saddle cloth. His family arms are not drawn.

head and shoulders portrait of Zbigniew Oleśnicki, the king's secretary of 20, no armour: a long dark cleric's gown, a dark skullcap over a tonsure-short haircut, no beard, a light horse with a plain saddle cloth; in his hand the stump of a broken lance .

head and shoulders portrait of Konrad von Lichtenstein, Grand Commander, a knight brother in the white mantle with the black cross on a big dark horse with a white caparison, like hero_wallenrode, but with an open bascinet and a sword at the hip beside the lance .

head and shoulders portrait of Prince Konstanty Ostrogski, hetman, about 40, dark beard, rich plate under a crimson kaftan with gold, an open gilt-rimmed sallet, a gold Orthodox cross, the hetman's bulawa. His arms are not drawn (not verified): a plain dark saddle cloth.

head and shoulders portrait of Prince Konstanty Ostrogski in flight, about 47, greyed beard. the card: , so no Muscovite kaftan and no armour: a plain dark riding coat to below the knee, a fur cap, a sabre drawn in the hand , a plain horse (a chestnut) with an ordinary saddle and the team saddle cloth. Cut and colours of the coat are a guess (nothing in the sources): kept plain and dark, no gold, no arms.

head and shoulders portrait of Heinrich von Plauen, komtur of Świecie, the defender of Malbork, a man of about forty: a lean, hard, tired face (hollow cheeks, a heavy brow, a short grizzled beard, the shoulders a little bowed), an open bascinet, plate arms over mail, the knight brother's white mantle with the black cross and nothing else: no rank insignia, a plain white shield, the lance with a team pennon , a dark bay horse under a white caparison with the cross. Beside him on foot a grey-mantled half-brother (the T cross of folk.to_halfbrother) with the Order's banner, white with the black cross.

head and shoulders portrait of Fritz Raweneck, the captain of the Order's mercenaries, a soldierly type: well-worn dark russeted half armour with plate arms, a mail skirt and boots, a short black tabard edged in ochre, an open sallet with the bevor over a lean face with a grizzled short beard and a heavy moustache, a sword raised , a dun horse with a team saddle cloth. No arms drawn.

head and shoulders portrait of Heinrich Reuss von Plauen, the Grand Hospitaller holding Chojnice, about 50, a different man from the Plauen of Malbork: a full, square, clean-shaven face, greying hair, a sallet with the bevor, plate of the 1450s under the knight brother's white mantle with the black cross, a white shield with the cross, a sword , a black horse under a white caparison with the cross.
head and shoulders portrait of a Samogitian hunter in a sheepskin coat, with a bow and an axe.

head and shoulders portrait of Wojciech Sampoliński, rotmistrz of the royal court banners (): bright full plate with plate legs, a round armet with the visor raised and a red and white plume (not a sallet, unlike the Duchy's lancers), a short crimson tabard, the court banner in his hand: the White Eagle crowned in gold on red , a grey horse with a chanfron and a crimson saddle cloth edged in white.

head and shoulders portrait of the voivode Daniil Shchenya, mature, full beard, a gilt shishak, a bakhterets over mail under a red ferjaz, a pernach; his bearer on foot in a tegilyai carries a dark red banner with the rider spearing the serpent (coa_mo: the rider of the seals of Ivan III, without the later eagle).

head and shoulders portrait of Stach of Łęczyca, Jaśko's grandson, 19: a bright new breastplate with a ridge and new pauldrons that he is trying on in the opening scene, plate arms, a red brigandine skirt below it, an open sallet over a young beardless face with fair hair, a lance with a team pennon , a small plain shield like his grandfather's (the doc's is not drawn), a chestnut horse with a team saddle cloth.

head and shoulders portrait of the stranger in red, a merry man on foot without armour or weapons: a red kaftan to the knees with gold buttons and a team sash, a red cap with a fur band, dark hair and a short beard, boots; idle and walk only. Nothing supernatural shows.

head and shoulders portrait of Janusz (the doc: Jan) Świerczowski. the card: he led the Polish mercenary horse. A mercenary captain in blackened half armour (breast, back, pauldrons, arms, a fauld; the legs in hose and riding boots, no leg plate), a wide black beret with a white feather, a short beard, a straight sword drawn , a plain bay with a red and white saddle cloth. His arms are not drawn.

head and shoulders portrait of three burghers of the Prussian towns walking as one unit in good dark cloth: an elder in a long black-blue gown with a fur collar and a chaperon, holding out a letter with a hanging red seal; one in a dark brown gown with a felt hat; one in a dark green gown with a hood. No town arms are drawn (the card names four towns; whose envoys these are the game does not say). Idle and walk only.
head and shoulders portrait of the Grand Marshal, a knight brother in the white cloak on a big horse.
head and shoulders portrait of Prince Yuri, her son, about 16 (b. c. 1492), : a slight rider in a too-big breastplate and an open sallet, a sabre drawn , a grey horse with the team cloth.

head and shoulders portrait of Zyndram of Maszkowice, sword-bearer of Kraków, short and stocky (a broad breastplate, the figure a little smaller), full armour of 1410 under a plain red surcoat (his arms are not drawn), an open bascinet with a dark beard, a mace , a bay horse with a red caparison.
head and shoulders portrait of rich mail with a bakhterets of small plates, a shishak with a mail barmitsa, a lance, a sabre, a round shield, a coloured chaprak.
close view of the Muscovite light gun: folk_1500.FieldGun with its two gunners dressed in undyed quilted tegilyai and fur-banded caps. The carriage is the same model (unpainted wood).

head and shoulders portrait of a monk on foot in a black ryasa and klobuk with its veil, a long beard, an icon in a kiot on a pole (the spell ; the face is not drawn, at this scale it is a spot); cast raises the icon over his head.

head and shoulders portrait of a Muscovite border watchman on a small horse: a quilted tegilyai as on mo_syn_boyarsky but of faded undyed cloth, a cloth cap with a fur band instead of a helmet, the composite bow in hand , the saadak, a sabre. The doc's one or two dogs beside him are not drawn (there is no dog model yet; they would be a separate unit).

head and shoulders portrait of pomestie horseman: a quilted tegilyai with a high collar, a spheroconical helmet, the saadak with a composite bow, a sabre, short stirrups, a small horse, an eastern saddle with a high pommel.
head portrait of a brown bear
head portrait of European wisent, high legs and a high hump; nt_bear: a brown bear; nt_elk: an elk with palmate antlers; nt_boar: a dark bristly boar with tusks; nt_wolf: a grey wolf.
head portrait of a wild boar with tusks
head portrait of a European elk moose with broad antlers

head and shoulders portrait of the town's crossbowman, pl_crossbow in town clothes: a white tunic with red sleeves and the small red shield of Gdańsk (two white crosses) on the chest, a kettle hat, the steel-bowed crossbow, the belt hook and a quiver of bolts .

head and shoulders portrait of a burgher of the Gdańsk militia: a red padded jack with white sleeves (the town's colours), dark hose, a kettle hat, a spear , a heater shield with the arms of Gdańsk: two white crosses one above the other on red, without the crown (granted only in 1457).

head and shoulders portrait of a Gdańsk shipman of the garrison: a short tunic of dark wool, a leather apron to the knees, a knitted cap with a rolled brim, a broad shipwright's axe in the right hand and a hammer in the left . Team belt and hem.

head and shoulders portrait of an orphans' footman: a grey-brown padded jack with quilting seams, a kettle hat, a red chalice on the chest, the iron-bound war flail upright in the hand , three sulice (javelins) slung on the back, a knife at the belt.

close view of a short wide-mouthed iron houfnice with hoops on a wooden bed in a light cart with low sides, its muzzle over the tail board; two horses. On the march the horses pull it forward; standing and firing, the whole wagon is turned round so the muzzle faces the enemy (like folk_1500.FieldGun, it never unhitches): a flash, smoke and the recoil of the barrel's bed. A gunner with the linstock and a loader with the rammer on foot beside it.

close view of the orphans' war wagon: a heavy cart with high plank side boards and loopholes, a low front board, a red chalice on a white field painted on each side, a team band along the top, chains hanging at the corners for linking the tabor; two horses, a driver in a padded jack. Inside stand a handgunner and a man with a flail.
head and shoulders portrait of like the Samogitian but poorer: hides, a club, no mail, no shield, no cap.
head and shoulders portrait of an old man in a light linen robe, a staff, a leather bag; no horns, no idols.

head and shoulders portrait of a peasant of Duke Eric II's Pomerania sent to the Order: a grey-brown homespun coat to the knee with a team hem, a linen shirt, a hood with a short cape over the shoulders, linen leg wraps and bast shoes, a sickle at the rope belt, a wooden three-tined pitchfork with iron-shod tines held like a spear . The doc's flail and scythe are the same man; one model.
head and shoulders portrait of a Tatar horse archer, like gdl_tatar but simpler: no helmet, a sheepskin coat, a fur-rimmed cap, a composite bow, the saadak and a sabre, a small steppe horse.
head and shoulders portrait of a local peasant.
head portrait of a grey wolf
head and shoulders portrait of a hood with a pelerine (a gugel), a quilted coat, a longbow, a quiver of arrows, a tesak at the belt .
head and shoulders portrait of chapel-de-fer, red brigandine, a steel-bowed crossbow, the belt hook and a quiver of bolts at the hip; the base of to_crossbow without the Order's cross and pavise.

head and shoulders portrait of a hired foot soldier of the Bohemian and Silesian infantry at Orsha. : a kettle hat (chapel-de-fer), a quilted coat with the team hem, a long pike , a spade slung on the back (he digs the ditch at the tabor). A wider and taller frame: the pike reaches far.

head and shoulders portrait of a knight's servant on foot: a light quilted coat with a mail collar, a cheap iron cap, a sulica , a small round shield with his knight's colours (a white bend on red here) and a team rim, a hatchet at the belt.

close view of : a quilted coat, a kettle hat, a short iron barrel on a wooden tiller, the match in a serpentine by the breech, a powder bag and a flask at the belt. Attack crossbow as the hakownica of folk_1508 (aim, kick, lower), plus a muzzle flash and a puff of smoke that hangs where the shot went (the doc's ).

head and shoulders portrait of the light Serbian-style hussar of about 1500, : a long red cloth coat, a tall cloth cap with a fur band and a feather, the asymmetric wooden tarcza with its point raised at the top of the leading edge (painted, a team rim), a long light lance with a pennon , a sabre, a small light horse with a team saddle cloth.
head and shoulders portrait of a peasant (): a linen shirt to the knees, a brown sermięga coat with the team hem, leather shoes () over foot wraps, a cloth cap; an axe .

head and shoulders portrait of a knight's lance: pointed-visor bascinet, plate arms over a brigandine, shield and caparison with a family coat of arms (Topór: a white axe on red), a long lance with a pennon.
head and shoulders portrait of mail, a kapalin (kettle hat), a light spear , a small shield with the White Eagle on red, a small horse without a caparison, a team saddle cloth.

head and shoulders portrait of a pavise man: kettle hat, quilted coat, a short falchion , the big painted pavise with the White Eagle on red and a team rim carried on his back. work (the game plays it while the pavise is set up) shows the pavise planted on the ground in front of him and the man crouched behind it, peering over its top.

head and shoulders portrait of a nobleman of the Great Polish levy in whatever he owns: an old red brigandine with rivets over mail, mail sleeves, an old open bascinet with its aventail, a plain shield of painted wood (the doc's family arms are not drawn; the doc's three random variants are one model here), a lance with a team pennon , a sword at the hip, a plain bay horse, smaller than a knight's, with only a saddle cloth.

head and shoulders portrait of a priest (): a black cassock, a white surplice (komża) to the knees, a stole in the team colour, a tonsure, a cross on a staff; cast raises the cross over his head (taller frame, like mo_inok).

close view of a long flat-bottomed Vistula boat of planks (a szkuta-like river boat, 6.4 m) with raked ends, sitting in the water to its lower strakes (only the hull above the waterline is built, foam along it, so the sprite lies on the water tiles). Two rowers on the thwarts, each pulling a pair of oars, a steersman standing at the stern with the long steering oar, a crossbowman in the bow behind small pavises set along the gunwale (red with a white field and a team band), three iron-bound chests of silver and a barrel amidships, a team pennon on a short staff at the stern. Idle: it rocks at rest, the oars lifted. Walk: the stroke (oars dipped and swept back, the rowers leaning), the boat surging, a bow
head and shoulders portrait of a town spearman: chapel-de-fer, quilted coat, cloth hose, spear, a heater shield in town colours (blue and white).
close view of the Duchy's wagon (beasts.Wagon) under a white canvas with red hoops and a red lower edge, a kmet driving.
close view of a thick wrought-iron barrel with hoops on a wooden bed () without wheels, stone balls, a crew of three; it fires with a flash, smoke and recoil.
head and shoulders portrait of a crossbowman, a black cross on the tabard, a pavise on the back.
head and shoulders portrait of a western crusader in his own bright arms (or, a bend gules) on surcoat, shield and caparison, a crest on the helmet; not the Order's white cloak.
head and shoulders portrait of grey cloak with a black T-cross, mail, chapel helmet, spear.

close view of a Bohemian handgunner in the Order's pay, no Hussite chalice: a grey quilted coat, a kettle hat, the hand-gun on a wooden tiller with the match , a powder bag and a horn flask, a tesák at the belt.
head and shoulders portrait of open bascinet, mail over a gambeson, spear, shield with a black cross.

head and shoulders portrait of a mercenary horseman in half armour: breastplate, pauldrons and plate arms, a two-lame fauld, a sallet with a bevor, leather riding boots and dark hose (no leg plate), a short ochre tunic over the breastplate edged in dark green, a lance with a two-tailed team pennon , a dun horse of middle weight with a team saddle cloth.
head and shoulders portrait of German village clothes: a gugel hood, hose, leather shoes.
head and shoulders portrait of the Order's white cloak over dark vestments, tonsure, a book.
head and shoulders portrait of mail, a simple helmet, a spear, a small shield, a small local horse.

head and shoulders portrait of a German or Czech mercenary foot soldier of the 1450s: an open sallet, a brigandine of blue-grey cloth with rivet rows over a green doublet, particoloured hose (one leg ochre, one dark), a long spear held like a pike , a short falchion at the belt. Motley, but no landsknecht slashes.
head and shoulders portrait of an inconspicuous wayfarer: a grey hood, a staff, a bag; no weapons, no crosses.
head and shoulders portrait of a dry official in a dark cloak, a black cross on the sleeve, a tally board, a sack.
close view of the GDL wagon with a white cover and black crosses, a German driver.
